reply: Acme Cloud is a customer analytics platform for B2B software companies. It connects product usage, billing, and CRM data into one live model of every account, user, and dollar, then turns it into dashboards, smart alerts, and AI-powered insights. Teams use it to spot churn risk earlier, find expansion revenue, and avoid rebuilding reports in spreadsheets weekly. It serves revenue operations, customer success, product, and finance teams at B2B SaaS companies (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 1-2).

The Starter plan costs $49 per user per month. It includes up to 10 users, 5 data sources, 1 million events per month, ready-made dashboards, and email support with next business day response. This plan is designed for small teams replacing spreadsheet reporting (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3).

The Growth plan costs $99 per user per month and includes unlimited users, 25 data sources, 20 million events per month, AI insights and smart alerts, custom health scores, and priority support with a 4-hour response time. It is designed for scaling companies running revenue and product on data. The plan also offers a 60-minute onboarding call. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)
The Starter plan includes up to 1 million events per month. If you exceed this limit, Acme Cloud will contact you to discuss moving to the next plan. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3)

Yes, Acme Cloud offers a 14-day free trial for the Starter and Growth plans with no credit card required. For the Enterprise plan, the process starts with a 30-minute demo with the team (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 3).

Your data and questions are never used to train AI models shared across customers at Acme Cloud. This ensures your data privacy and security in AI model training. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 4)

Your data is encrypted both in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256 encryption. Additionally, Acme Cloud is SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR-ready, with role-based access control and a full audit log for security (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3).
Yes, you can choose EU hosting for your data when you sign up with Acme Cloud. This supports compliance with GDPR and other data residency requirements. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Acme Cloud connects to several CRMs including Salesforce and HubSpot as native connectors. It also integrates with other tools like Stripe, Chargebee, Segment, Zendesk, Intercom, and Slack. The platform syncs data frequently to keep dashboards and insights up to date (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 2). If you want details on ConnectWise Manage specifically, I can search again.

SSO (SAML) and SCIM user provisioning are included in the Enterprise plan of Acme Cloud. The Enterprise plan also offers custom data retention, a dedicated customer success manager, and a 99.99% uptime SLA. Starter and Growth plans do not include SSO. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Most teams see their first live dashboard the same day they connect a data source. Starter customers onboard with a self-serve guided setup, Growth customers get a 60-minute onboarding call, and Enterprise customers receive a dedicated customer success manager with a 30-day rollout plan. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)

Acme Cloud pricing is listed in US dollars and does not mention payment options in Indian rupees. Billing can be monthly or annual, with annual billing saving 15%. For specific payment options including currency, I can connect you with our sales team. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3)
The Growth plan includes 25 data sources. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf)

Acme Cloud does not list a native integration with Zoho CRM. Native connectors include Stripe, Chargebee, Salesforce, HubSpot, Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Zendesk, Intercom, and Slack. However, product events can be sent through Acme Cloud's JavaScript and Python SDKs or the REST events API, which might allow custom integration options. (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide)

Acme Cloud does not mention offering an on-premise version for installation on your own servers. The platform is cloud-based with data residency options in US or EU hosting when you sign up (Source: Acme Cloud — Product Guide, p. 3). If you want, I can connect you with the team for more details.

Acme Cloud is a fictional company created as demo data for the LeadPilot AI prototype, so there is no real CEO for the company. All names and figures are illustrative. (Source: acme-cloud-product-guide.pdf, p. 4)
